observations.observation: Body thunk reaches source preview body. Imported navigationTitle, inline title display mode and ShareLink calls are present. Exact style/highlighter behavior is unresolved.

Body binds ScrollPosition; chooses top or center depending on display mode; linked-line change callback is registered with initial=true at0x1a13868..0x1a13880. Geometry and phase changes have separate callbacks.
Thunk forwards optional Int and display mode to the reading-state action. Action has separate saved-position and linked-line branches, with previous-target comparison at0x1a13540.
The action stores the target, obtains UnitPoint.center at0x18a0a40 and calls ScrollPosition.scrollTo(id:anchor:). Saved-offset path separately calls scrollTo(y:) at0x1a13514.
